entities.name: ElevatorController
responsibilities: Receive hall calls from every floor
Pick the best car for each request
Move cars between floors and open doors
Track the position of every car

entities.name: ElevatorCar
responsibilities: Hold its current floor and direction
Keep a sorted list of stops

entities.name: ElevatorState
responsibilities: List car states: IDLE, MOVING_UP, MOVING_DOWN, DOORS_OPEN

entities.name: Request
responsibilities: Store the source floor, direction and time of a hall call

entities.name: NearestCarDispatcher
responsibilities: Choose the car closest to the requested floor that is idle or already moving towards it

entities.name: HallButton
responsibilities: Light up when pressed and send a hall call

patterns.name: Strategy
patterns.why: So we can switch to other dispatch algorithms later.

keyFlows:
Hall call: HallButton.press() -> ElevatorController.requestElevator(floor, dir) -> NearestCarDispatcher.selectCar(cars, request) -> car.addStop(floor).
Every tick, ElevatorController.step() moves each car one floor; when a car reaches a stop it opens the door, waits one tick, and closes it.
Car call: a passenger presses a floor inside the car -> car.addStop(floor).
tradeOffs: Nearest-car dispatch is simple but can starve far floors when traffic is heavy.
assumptions: All cars serve all floors. Time advances in discrete ticks.
